finding: Q23 adds a candidate visual-seed -> evidence-bound UnifiedDB ref -> EAP/ClayGraph neighborhood path. ClayGraph remains relevance/accessibility only; retrieved relations cannot replace sensor evidence, mint truth or grant effect authority. Shuffled topology, contradictory edges and stale graph/hash are explicit controls.
counterhypotheses: A coherent wrong neighborhood can amplify a mistaken visual identity.
Direct exact/FTS retrieval may match or exceed graph-assisted utility with lower maintenance and latency.
Stale or noisy topology may erase any associative benefit.
required_validation: TO-Q23-010 perception-only versus EAP-guided active-sensing ablation.
ancestry_policy: Q23 graph and Retina/EAP artifacts share one development lineage
